'''The Barrier''' was a formation of solid rock located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It lay at the entrance to [[Tusken Canyon]].<ref name="TM" />
